leaves.name: homFreeFiniteAlgClosedNoEmb
leaves.doc: Mumford, Abelian varieties (1970), 19 Thm 3, specialized to algebraically closed fields with no ring homomorphism to C (characteristic p, or characteristic 0 of transcendence degree above the continuum); over fields that embed into C the statement is proved (homfree-proof). Locator UNVERIFIED.
leaves.flag: specialization (forall-instance) of the printed theorem to fields with no embedding into C; no consumer of T6 uses such a field (homfree-proof section 4)
leaves.source: Mumford 19 Thm 3 (fields with no embedding into C)
